item.title: Australia: Responsible AI Network for Victoria Youth Services
item.description: Swinburne University has launched the Responsible AI in Youth Sectors Network (RAI YSN) to guide ethical and effective adoption of AI across all youth-focused services and community programmes in Victoria

item.title: India: Boosting Cyber Resilience, Safeguarding Citizens
item.description: India has strengthened cybercrime prevention and financial fraud protection through I4C, advanced platforms, inter-agency coordination, training and robust measures across key sectors, boosting resilience.

item.title: Hong Kong: UniVenture Boosts Student-Led Innovation at HKUST
item.description: HKUST and an investment partner launch UniVenture to incubate student-led AI and technology startups through funding mentorship and commercialisation support.

item.title: Vietnam: The Role of Trust in Shaping the Digital Economy
item.description: Vietnam highlighted trust as the foundation of its next phase of digital development at Internet Day 2025, focusing on a safe, inclusive Internet to support sustainable socio-economic growth and robust digital institutions.

item.title: Malaysia: Media Innovation Fund to Strengthen Digital Capabilities
item.description: Malaysia has launched the Media Innovation Fund to strengthen digital skills, support content innovation and enhance the technological readiness of the media sector as part of its broader digital transformation agenda.

item.title: Indonesia’s Strategic Foray in AI and Semiconductor Industry
item.description: Indonesia is accelerating its semiconductor and AI development, strategically leveraging mineral resources and international partnerships to fully enter the global supply chain and achieve digital and AI sovereignty.

item.title: Australia, UK Universities Unite to Advance Defence Tech Skills
item.description: The UK–Australia Advanced Skills Alliance brings universities from both countries together to develop advanced skills, research collaboration and workforce capability to support emerging defence and security technologies.

item.title: The Philippines: Transforming Local Services for a Smart Nation
item.description: Naval launches the Naval Connect App, a fully citizen-focused digital platform that efficiently streamlines government services and positions the town at the forefront of smart, technology-driven local governance.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST to Lead Advanced Lunar Robotics Project
item.description: HKUST will lead the development of an AI-enabled dual-arm lunar robot to support Chang’E-8, advance autonomous surface exploration capabilities safely and enable future international lunar research initiatives.

item.title: Vietnam: Strategic Digital Breakthroughs to Drive Growth
item.description: Vietnam is accelerating science, innovation and digital transformation reforms to strengthen governance, boost productivity and unlock growth through integrated institutional, infrastructure and skills development.
